packageRules.description: npm deps and regular `uses: owner/repo@sha` action pins are already handled by .github/dependabot.yml. Renovate exists solely for what Dependabot's github-actions parser explicitly does not support: Docker image digests in a job's `container:`/`services:` fields, or a `uses: docker://...` step (confirmed by reading dependabot-core's file_parser.rb, which skips `docker://` refs with a standing TODO and never inspects `container:` at all) - see docs/supply-chain-security.md.
The actually-active rule: Docker image digests (e.g. supply-chain.yml's semgrep/semgrep container). Same 7-day cooldown as .github/dependabot.yml, stated explicitly here too.
